versions.content: Use cases for a ServiceSwComponentType to express ServiceNeeds There are valid use cases for a ServiceSwComponentType to express ServiceNeeds 2 . This leads to a situation where ServiceSwComponent- Type s are iteratively created in response to ServiceNeeds expressed by other Ser- viceSwComponentType s. Please refer to the [4, AUTOSAR TR Methodology] for more details about how this shall be implemented into the workflow.
